notes: Bright green matcha latte with rosetta art and a few rose petals in a faceted glass, on a white saucer over warm wood slats. Seen from a 3/4 angle, centred, and it fills the centre square, so a circle crop keeps the glass and saucer (only the spoon handle gets clipped). Warm and appetising, no text. Runner-up (Daniel Stiel, 3CzGKfWfYEk): iced matcha in a glass on a wooden coaster against plain white, seen from a 3/4 overhead angle. It is the cleanest cut-out look and suits the Tea hero tint. The glass sits slightly low in the portrait frame.

Top-down shot of a creamy foamed drink dusted with cinnamon, on a light wooden board in warm daylight. It reads as a chai latte and fits the cream and wood palette. The round rim is centred, so it works well as a circle. A small steel straw pokes out to the right. Runner-up (Phil Desforges, Nw8wbiDE3gU): square, top-down latte with spice-flecked crema and a rosetta on a grey saucer over darker wood. It is a perfect circle fit, but it looks more like a classic latte and may clash with the coffee group's latte or cappuccino photos.

Side view of a tall clear glass of very dark iced coffee with a thin creamy head, on a plain white studio background. A mound of roasted beans covers the base. The subject is centred and the frame is almost square, so it reads as a cut-out on the Cold hero tint. It is a little studio-stock but clean and sharp. Runner-up (Mayur, vP9TjdIm9fE): dark iced coffee in a clear glass on a round wooden table with a soft, bright blurred café behind. It is warmer and more natural, but the background is busier.

Side view of milk being poured into iced coffee in a clear glass, with marbled milk-and-coffee layers, on bright white marble. Very appetising. The glass is centred in the lower half. The top of the centre square shows the pitcher and part of a hand, which is not dominant, and a circle crop trims most of it. A few out-of-focus meringues sit at the edges. Runner-up (Hannah Reid, LPDn9x-F6GM): an iced latte in a cut-crystal glass with cinnamon on the ice, against a light marble and white wall. It is clean, centred and has no hands, but it is fully mixed rather than layered. For a classic layered look on a darker background, there is also ZwnAW9dFAuI (photo-1671759545218-831c32bfe92d, Caramel).

Golden iced peach tea in a clear glass, with two peach slices on a bamboo skewer resting on top and a foamy top with ice. Shot from a 3/4 angle on a warm wooden table with a quilted coaster, in warm light that matches the palette. The glass and peaches sit inside the centre square. The skewer reaches the right edge and the top-left background is darker wood. Runner-up (Tkhao Khoang, IvyJqrkq1Zc): top-down view straight into a round glass of iced tea with big peach slices. It is the most circle-friendly shot, with the glass filling about 80% of the width and reading clearly even at 56px. The background is dark navy, though a circle crop shows only a thin ring of it.

For the banner: a wide frame (about 16:9, 5824x3259) of milk being poured into a white cup with a heart forming, held in one hand. The background is warm, blurred wood and the light is a soft golden tone. The cup sits centre-right, leaving the left side free for the headline and code chip. There are no logos. Runner-up (Tim Umphreys, Lmz2D7ZLhJM): a 3:2 close-up of a pitcher pouring a rosetta into a small white cup, with crisp detail and a bright, softly blurred espresso bar behind. It is cooler and brighter, with fingers visible at the bottom.

For the banner: a 3:2 macro of glossy roasted beans with shallow depth of field and a warm amber glow. Premium and warm, with the focus sharp in the centre. Runner-up (Anastasiia Chepinska, lcfH0p6emhw): a flat, edge-to-edge top-down texture of medium-roast beans in lighter, even warm browns. It is better behind overlaid text because it has no focal point and the tone is uniform.
